info.name: formly-prize-engine
info.description: Root + Health + API v1. 0 Root. 1 Health. 2-3 Create Prize. 4 Get Prize. 5 Payment Intent. 6 Verify payment. 7 Pay. Variables: baseUrl, serviceToken, prizeId.

item.name: 1. Health
item.description: GET /api/health. Polling / load balancer. Response: { status, service, timestamp }.

item.name: 2. Create Prize (USDC)
item.description: Create a USDC prize. Body: rewardType, distributionMode, prizeAmount, optional feePercent (0-100, default 10). Response 201: { prize: { prizeId, status, rewardType, distributionMode, prizeAmount, feePercent, feeAmount, prizeNet, vaultAddress, createdAt, updatedAt } }. Copy prizeId to collection variable.

item.name: 3. Create Prize (XLM)
item.description: Create an XLM prize. Same body and response format.

item.name: 4. Get Prize
item.description: Get the prize. If already paid, response includes payments: [{ destination, amount }, ...].

item.name: 5. Create Payment Intent (XDR to sign)
item.description: Generate unsigned XDR. Body: payerPublicKey (wallet that will pay, G... 56 chars). Response: unsignedXdr, memo, depositTarget, feeTarget, expiresAt, expectedPayments, feePercent. Requires prizeId of a prize in AWAITING_PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION.

item.name: 6. Verify payment
item.description: Only prizeId in URL. Queries vault_deposits (filled by polling). If valid deposit found, marks LOCKED. Body: {} or {"txHash":"..."}.

item.name: 7. Pay
item.description: Sends prize_net to wallets. Body: destinations (array of G...). Prize must be LOCKED or CLOSED.
